review:
John Hunter in an Anubis-themed book slot. The book with the Eye of Anubis is wild and scatter, and three give 10 free spins with an expanding symbol – classic format.

The difference is Super Spins: for 10x your stake per spin, every spin plays like a free spin with the expanding symbol. That can eat a balance fast, so definitely try it in demo first. Up to 5,000x, 96.5% RTP.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo

Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
